Legal

Privacy Policy

How we handle information when you visit and use this website.

Draft — pending legal review

This document is a working draft provided for transparency while the Think Positive Always website is being developed. It has not yet been reviewed by a legal professional and will be updated before commercial features such as purchases, accounts, or newsletter subscriptions are launched.

Last updated: October 20, 2026

1. Who we are

This website is operated by Think Positive Always ("Think Positive Always", "we", "us"). Full legal entity and contact details will be added to this policy before commercial services launch.

2. Information we collect today

At this stage, the website does not offer accounts, purchases, contact forms, or newsletter sign-ups, and we do not ask you to submit personal information through the site.

Like most websites, our hosting provider may automatically process limited technical information when you visit, such as your IP address, browser type, device information, and the pages you request. This is used to deliver the website securely and reliably.

3. Information we may collect in the future

As we introduce new features, we may collect:

  • Your email address if you subscribe to our newsletter.
  • Account details if you create a customer account.
  • Order information for digital product purchases. Payment details will be handled by a verified third-party payment provider; we do not intend to store full card details.
  • Messages you choose to send us.
  • Website usage analytics to help us improve content and performance.

This policy will be updated to describe each feature before it goes live.

4. Cookies

The website does not currently use advertising or analytics cookies. If we introduce cookies or similar technologies, we will update this policy and, where required, request your consent.

5. How we use information

  • To operate, secure, and maintain the website.
  • To provide services you request, such as newsletters or downloads, once available.
  • To understand how the website is used so we can improve it.
  • To comply with legal obligations.

6. Sharing information

We do not sell personal information. We may share information with service providers who help us operate the website (for example, hosting, email, or payment providers), only as needed to provide their services.

7. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict the use of your personal information. Details on how to exercise these rights will be provided here once contact channels are published.

8. Children

This website is intended for adults and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

9. Changes to this policy

We will update this policy as the website develops. The "Last updated" date above shows when it was last revised.

10. Contact

If you have questions about this document, please visit our contact page for the current ways to reach us.
